Not Free:

Users using Tor can be identified through correlation, if both exit node and entry node are compromised so are you. They can check the time of the sent and received packets, see any unencrypted data at the exit node and see your location at the entry node. To circumvent this run HTTPS everywhere(free) and purchase a VPN server and run it as your designated entry node.
